title: narcissus minor var. villarvildensis
intro: Narcissus minor var. villarvildensis, commonly known as the lesser narcissus or miniature daffodil, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and to possess antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus minor var. villarvildensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and other compounds that have been shown to have sedative and antioxidant effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include galantamine, which has been used to treat conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, and other compounds that have been found to have potential in the treatment of various health conditions.
